programme.desc: Episod ini Wind, Rickman, Lin Zhi Xiang dan Baki berada di sebuah ladang biri-biri di Johor untuk bersaing menangkap biri-biri yang telah ditanda. Peserta yang kalah harus menghalau biri-biri kembali ke dalam kandang.

programme.title: WOMEN WALK THE LINE
programme.desc: Gu Qiao mendapati suaminya Ruan Yu curang pada malam sebelum mereka berkahwin. Dia mendedahkan hubungan sulit suaminya dengan perempuan lain secara terbuka pada majlis perkahwinan mereka.

programme.title: ANONYMOUS SIGNAL
programme.desc: Pasukan ASIB menyiasat kes Shuang Qian ditembak oleh Ling Lek. Pak Fei mengesyaki bahawa Julie ada berkaitan dengan seorang penjahat Zhung Wai Hin. Zhung Wai Hin dibunuh oleh Pak Fei dalam satu insiden tembak-menembak.

programme.title: MY TWIN LOVER
programme.desc: Hou Qin menjalankan tugas Hou Ming dan Hou Ming pula menjalankan tugas Hou Qin. Wei Yun, tunang Hou Qin mendapati Hou Qin (sebenarnya Hou Ming) sudah berubah sikap dan amat menyayanginya. Oleh itu, dia amat gembira.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Polis menemui kereta Yu Jin di dasar laut bersama mayat An Jie, memicu tekad Zai Xing untuk menuntut keadilan. Walau bagaimanapun, keberadaan Yu Jin dan jawapan sebenar di sebalik tragedi ini masih menjadi tanda tanya.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: An Jie cuba memberitahu Li Ping dan Yi LIn bahawa Qing Tian telah meninggal dunia dan tubuhnya kini dirasuki roh An Jia. Namun setiap kali percubaan An Jie telah dihalang oleh kejadian yang aneh dan tidak dapat dijelaskan.

programme.title: THE QUEEN OF NEWS 2
programme.desc: Apabila insiden tebusan semakin meruncing, Sze-ching campur tangan selaku pegawai penerangan. Beliau mencadangkan siaran bersama julung kali antara SNK News dan Open Platform demi meredakan ketegangan yang berlaku.

programme.title: PURSUIT OF JADE
programme.desc: Pakcik Zhao, jiran Chang Yu, dan penduduk-penduduk lain tampil untuk membantu setelah mendapati Jin Ye menceroboh masuk untuk mencuri geran rumah Chang Yu. Chang Yu turut bergegas pulang untuk mengusir musuh setelah dimaklumkan.

programme.title: MY STAR FAMILY 3
programme.desc: Satu salah faham kecil antara Yue Mei (ibu) dan Jin Chai (ayah) telah merenggangkan hubungan mereka. Keira dan adik-beradiknya mengajar Yue Mei menggunakan penapis kecantikan AI, untuk menghilangkan rasa bosannya.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF HEROES
programme.desc: Mu Nianci menyelamatkan seorang murid dan diberitahu keberadaan Kitab Strategi Perang Wu Mu. Zhou Botong pula diserang formasi ular Ou YangKe. Dia berkeras untuk menjadi saudara Guo Jing yang mengeluarkan racun ular dari lukanya.

programme.title: AMUSING RACE SEASON 2
programme.desc: Episod ini menyaksikan Wind, Rickman, Lin Zhi Xiang dan Baki beraksi di pantai Setiu, Terengganu. Pelbagai cabaran fizikal bertemakan pantai dan kelapa menanti mereka lengkap dengan hukuman lucu serta menggelikan.

programme.title: WOMEN WALK THE LINE
programme.desc: Gu Giao hampir terpedaya dengan seorang lelaki yang menjemput dia ke bilik hotelnya, jika tidak dihalang oleh Yuan Ge. Giao memfailkan perceraian, tapi dikehendaki membayar balik pinjaman yang diambil ibunya daripada keluarga Ruan Yu.

programme.title: ANONYMOUS SIGNAL
programme.desc: Rumah keselamatan ASIB yang melindungi Zhi Yi dan Kak Ngo diserang oleh orang Lei Kin Woh. Zhi Yi, Kak Ngo dan Shuang Shuang diculik dan Chi Chiu tercdera. Lei Kin Woh dengan yang berpakaian berlumuran darah tiba di balai polis.

programme.title: MY TWIN LOVER
programme.desc: Hou Ming (sebenarnya Hou Qin) berhasrat memajukan kedai barangan terpakai dan berbincang dengan Ah Chang untuk merangka pelan promosi. Sikapnya yang berubah menolak tauhu busuk pemberian Coco mula menimbulkan persoalan.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: An Jie cuba memberitahu Li Ping dan Yi LIn bahawa Qing Tian telah meninggal dunia dan tubuhnya kini dirasuki roh An Jia. Namun setiap kali percubaan An Jie telah dihalang oleh kejadian yang aneh dan tidak dapat dijelaskan.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Ya Jie dan Dong Jun mengenang semula detik-detik bersama An JIe. Ya Jie dan Dong Jun merasa sedih dan menyesal bekerjasama dengan Cheng Sheng dan secara tidak langsung menyebabkan kematian An Jie.

programme.title: THE QUEEN OF NEWS 2
programme.desc: Man menghadiri acara perniagaan dalam usahanya mencari penyokong kewangan. Walaupun diejek oleh Puan Fong kerana berurusan dengan media dalam talian, Man bertemu dengan Diana Pak, seorang usahawan yang mempunyai pemikiran serupa.

programme.title: PURSUIT OF JADE
programme.desc: Pada malam perkahwinan Chang Yu, bapa saudara dan ibu saudaranya bersembunyi di luar rumah untuk mengintai pasangan pengantin itu, dengan niat untuk memastikan sama ada perkahwinan Chang Yu dan Yan Zheng itu benar.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF HEROES
programme.desc: Hong Qigong terus bertempur dengan Ou Yangfeng ekoran pertengkaran. Huang Yaoshi muncul untuk menjadi orang tengah konflik mereka. Huang Yaoshi meletakkan 3 cabaran kepada Guo Jing dan Ou Yangke untuk bersaing secara adil.

programme.title: Guqin Music Art
programme.desc: The guqin is an instrument with a history of over 3,000 years. Yet in all that time, its design and sound have remained virtually unchanged. In 2003, the guqin and its music were proclaimed as part of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO. But how has this ancient instrument withstood the musical test of time? How do its slow, gentle melodies resonate in fast-paced modern China? In this episode of The Inheritors, we explore guqin music art's history, development in modern days, and its future.

programme.title: Guqin Music Art
programme.desc: The guqin is an instrument with a history of over 3,000 years. Yet in all that time, its design and sound have remained virtually unchanged. In 2003, the guqin and its music were proclaimed as part of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO. But how has this ancient instrument withstood the musical test of time? How do its slow, gentle melodies resonate in fast-paced modern China? In this episode of The Inheritors, we explore guqin music art's history, development in modern days, and its future.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: China Bound: Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it's said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it's said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: Tibetan Medicine Man
programme.desc: This episode documents the daily lives of Lorge Phuntsok and his family of Tibetan doctors, and how they're helping patients overcome these challenges. Through their story, we explore the efforts being made to improve medical care in China in recent years, and their successes and failures. We record how the Dzongsar Tibetan Hospital is helping to improve the standard of living for local Tibetans by offering free consultations to the poor, setting up rural clinics, and training village doctors and midwives. We explore how the hospital is embracing modern science and e-commerce to develop and promote Tibetan medicine, and in turn, is helping to give this 3,800 year old practice a new beginning.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing's Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance - featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon - and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as "Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate," "Mudfish Eating Dumplings," and "Three Dragons." Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China's most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: Now, Guizhou Ep.1

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: Tibetan Medicine Man
programme.desc: This episode documents the daily lives of Lorge Phuntsok and his family of Tibetan doctors, and how they're helping patients overcome these challenges. Through their story, we explore the efforts being made to improve medical care in China in recent years, and their successes and failures. We record how the Dzongsar Tibetan Hospital is helping to improve the standard of living for local Tibetans by offering free consultations to the poor, setting up rural clinics, and training village doctors and midwives. We explore how the hospital is embracing modern science and e-commerce to develop and promote Tibetan medicine, and in turn, is helping to give this 3,800 year old practice a new beginning.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing's Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance - featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon - and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as "Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate," "Mudfish Eating Dumplings," and "Three Dragons." Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China's most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: Tibetan Medicine Man
programme.desc: This episode documents the daily lives of Lorge Phuntsok and his family of Tibetan doctors, and how they're helping patients overcome these challenges. Through their story, we explore the efforts being made to improve medical care in China in recent years, and their successes and failures. We record how the Dzongsar Tibetan Hospital is helping to improve the standard of living for local Tibetans by offering free consultations to the poor, setting up rural clinics, and training village doctors and midwives. We explore how the hospital is embracing modern science and e-commerce to develop and promote Tibetan medicine, and in turn, is helping to give this 3,800 year old practice a new beginning.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing's Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance - featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon - and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as "Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate," "Mudfish Eating Dumplings," and "Three Dragons." Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China's most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Bo-kyung
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a top-notch vocalist and songwriter Kim Bo-kyung (Neon)! This artist first made herself known to the public in 2010 through Superstar K2 and caused a real sensation with her rendition of Kelly Clarkson's Because of You. The following year she made her official debut with the first mini-album The First Day and then took part in the soundtracks of numerous TV series and films starting with School 2013. Recently Kim Bo-kyung (Neon) dropped the new digital single Why Am I? It's her first new song in 5 months with an intense guitar riff and band sound. 5 months back she released the song Let's Walk Through The Flower Path to offer a message of comfort to listeners as we are all going through the pandemic era. In this episode this musician performs That night That day (010)Unknown Call Let's Walk Through The Flower Path Love Yourself Why Am I? and Don't Think You're Alone. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy Kim Bo-kyung (Neon)'s kaleidoscopic musicality!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Meaningful Stone
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Meaningful Stone! Since releasing her debut single Camera in My Dreams in July 2017 she has garnered much attention with her self-produced music videos and live performance videos on YouTube. Naturally she became one of the most aspiring indie musicians in the Korean music scene who was also highly praised by renowned music critic and writer Bae Soon-tak. This past September Meaningful Stone released her first full-length album a call from my dreams which is named after the lead single off the album. As the title implies the song is about a call she received in her dreams when she was struggling with life’s ups and downs. As opposed to reality she was continuously speaking words of love to herself while dreaming. She shares that hopeful message with listeners to offer a moment of comfort. In this episode Meaningful Stone performs a call from my dream nameless treasure hunt if I grow up as if and beep-boop-beep-boop. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and check out her unpredictable yet genuine musicality!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jukjae
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is guitarist and singer-songwriter Jukjae! This artist initially made his reputation in the music scene as a session guitarist composer and arranger. Then in April 2014 he released a self-written song View through the compilation album bright #2 and his debut album One Word in November officially starting a singing career of his own. Thanks to his dexterity in playing guitar he has played with a number of top musicians including Park Hyo-shin Kim Dong-ryul IU and more. Last month in November Jukjae released his second mini-album 2006 the year Jukjae describes as “the most beautiful and innocent time” in his life. With the lead single Shining My 2006 he hopes people will look back at the time they were at their brightest and happiest to escape reality for a brief moment. In this episode Jukjae performs Shining My 2006 The Door Do You Want To Walk With Me? Let's Go See the Stars and View. Tune in to I'm LIVE and take a glimpse into his artistry!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - GB9
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the talented vocalist duo GB9! GB9 is composed of Gil-gu and Bong-gu who were known for their exceptional singing skills even before their debut. They sang for a number of top-notch artists as backup vocalists including Lee Juck Park Hyo-shin Kim Jo-han Taeyang Baek Z Young Gummy Lynn Kim Tae-woo and more. The two are also top vocal coaches who taught B1A4 BTOB and Oh My Girl. In 2013 the two made their official debut with the single Going Crazy and instantly captured listeners' hearts. In 2017 the duo's 2014 single I hope it's a breeze made it to the Melon Top 100 Chart and once again proved that the song is a timeless classic. From The King of Mask Singer to Immortal Songs: Singing the Legend the two took part in various music shows and impressed viewers with their artistry. Last month in November GB9 released an emotional ballad called If I knew touching listeners once more in this cold season. In this episode GB9 performs their latest single If I knew and biggest hit I hope it's a breeze among others. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy their flawless performance!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Ha Hyun-sang
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Ha Hyun-sang! This artist made his big debut in February 2018 with the single Dawn. Since then he has released two mini-albums and a number of singles and also taken part in the soundtracks of top TV series such as Mr. Sunshine Melo Is My Nature A Piece of Your Mind and Soul Mechanic. Last year he participated in a talent show for indie musicians Super Band as a member of Hoppipolla and managed to finish first. Last month Ha Hyun-sang released his new single 3108 which is about a guy wanting to go back in time to correct his past mistakes. Full of heartrending sentiments this song is more than good enough to get a glimpse into his fantastic artistry. In this episode Ha Hyun-sang performs 3108 Nostalgia A Book of Love and more to show off his talents. Tune in to I'm LIVE and let this artist melt your heart!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - 10CM
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter 10CM! 10CM is a solo act that initially started a band consisting of two members. The name referred to the height difference between them - 10 cm. In 2017 however one had to leave the group due to personal reasons and the main vocalist Kwon Jung-yeol continued on as a one-person band on his own under the name 10CM. In March 10CM held the first #TogetherAtHome concert in Korea after watching Coldplay singer Chris Martin perform a live concert online for people stuck indoors due to the spread of the coronavirus. Then in October the artist held a real-time online solo performance for the first time as a non-idol musician. In this episode 10CM performs songs from his latest album Winter Breath and Before Our Night Is Over as well as his hits pet Phonecert and Stalker to delight our ears and souls. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and fill your heart with Christmas vibes with 10CM!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Lim Heon-il
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Lim Heon-il! This artist made his big debut in the music scene after winning the Bronze Award at the 15th Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest in 2004. Since then he has actively pursued his career both as a guitarist and vocalist. As a guitarist he has played for a number of Korea's top artists including Kim Dong-ryul Lim Jae-beom and Lee So-ra. He's also been part of many renowned bands such as iamnot Mate Jeong Won-young Band and Band Bremen. Then in 2013 this artist transformed into a solo artist with the album Becoming a Love. Last year Lim Heon-il took part in Begin Again Season 3 and once again showed off his prowess as a guitarist and vocalist. Then in April this year he released his second album Breathe after a break of 7 years. All the songs in the album were composed written and produced by Lim Heon-il himself perfectly quenching listeners' thirst. In this episode Lim Heon-il performs Leave Home and Everything from his new album RBTY and many other songs to delight viewers. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy the essence of his artistry!

He's also been part of many renowned bands such as iamnot Mate Jeong Won-young Band and Band Bremen. Then in 2013 this artist transformed into a solo artist with the album Becoming a Love. Last year Lim Heon-il took part in Begin Again Season 3 and once again showed off his prowess as a guitarist and vocalist. Then in April this year he released his second album Breathe after a break of 7 years. All the songs in the album were composed written and produced by Lim Heon-il himself perfectly quenching listeners' thirst. In this episode Lim Heon-il performs Leave Home and Everything from his new album RBTY and many other songs to delight viewers. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy the essence of his artistry!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - ONEWE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the talented quintet ONEWE! ONEWE is an alternative rock band composed of YongHoon KangHyun HaRin DongMyeong and CyA. The band's name is a combination of one and and we shine on you which speaks to the members' ambition to shine on everyone and become one in the name of music. With exceptional talents in songwriting and lyric-writing the five young musicians never fail to impress listeners. Not surprisingly the quintet is expanding their audience reach both at home and abroad and their single Q entered the Billboard World Digital Song Sales Chart in April last year. Each member boasts his own distinctive musical talents so their music is versatile and kaleidoscopic yet harmonious. In this episode ONEWE performs Regulus Crazy ONEWE Medley and more to show off their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these talented ambitious five artists!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jung Seung-hwan
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is superb vocalist Jung Seung-hwan! With his trademark heartwarming voice this artist is known for his winter songs including The Snowman and My Christmas Wish. In time for the season he's back with another winter classic - Winter Again. Topping all the major charts with his latest single he once again proved his mainstream popularity. Also he took part in the song Our Christmas Wish For You released by his label and genuinely comforted listeners going through this difficult time. In this episode Jung Seung-hwan performs The Snowman Whenever Wherever Fine and more to keep us warm during this cold season. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented vocalist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - JEONG SEWOON
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter JEONG SEWOON! Known for his exceptional songwriting skills and talents this artist has been nourishing the ears and souls of listeners since his official debut in 2017. In July last year JEONG SEWOON released his first full-length album 24. Composed of Part 1 and Part 2 it's filled with his ambition and passion for music. In particular the lead single In the Dark tells listeners that regardless of the situation they can shine brightly eventually offering a genuine message of hope. In this episode JEONG SEWOON performs In the Dark :m(MIND) Be a Fool and more to showcase his mature musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SANTAI 5-8
programme.desc: Segmen Santai 5-8 mengandungi zon muzik segmen Lagu 60 an pada Isnin Laguku Kuasa Dua pada Selasa Rabu Lagu dan Kenangan Khamis Secangkir Bicara/Nurul Al-Quran dan Jumaat La Khobar. Sabtu dan Ahad segmen Hello Hello MELAKAfm pilihan lagu dan ucapan pendengar

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. Turut disajikan 'Waronk Dangdut pada Sabtu dan Syok 80-90 pada Ahad.

programme.title: KONA MAI 2026
programme.desc: Rehatkan minda anda pada penghujung hari bersama Shah, Faruk & Mimie dalam segmen KONA MAI. Segmen ini membawakan pilihan lagu santai, pengisian rohani, serta seleksi lagu-lagu kesukaan anda di Tapaw Lagu @ Kafe Muzik. Sebelum melelapkan mata, nikmati alunan lagu-lagu melankolik terkini, bahasa Melayu, Inggeris, dan Indonesia untuk menemani malam anda dengan penuh kedamaian.

programme.title: GENG PAGI MUTIARA
programme.desc: Mulakan Pagi anda dengan penuh bersemangat bersama Chombi dan Bambam!\\n Segmen ini menyajikan gabungan lengkap untuk memulakan hari anda dengan positif—daripada pengisian rohani menerusi bacaan Al-Quran, nasyid, dan Santai Nurani, hinggalah kepada berita sahih, laporan trafik semasa, tajuk-tajuk akhbar utama, serta topik pagi yang santai dan menghiburkan. Jangan lupa layan lagu-lagu permintaan anda dalam slot Layan Pagi sebelum melangkah ke tengah hari!

programme.title: FOKUS MUTIARA
programme.desc: Sambil buat kerja atau berehat, penyampai kami Azie, Elly , Mimie & Fazrinah sedia menemani dengan pelbagai maklumat berguna dan hiburan menarik. Dapatkan petua serta tips gaya hidup serta pelbagai perkongsian harian yang terkini. Nikmati juga kelainan irama Bollywood menerusi Syoknya Hindi & mengimbau memori menerusi Everlasting Memory dengan lagu retro Inggeris terbaik serta laporan berita Warta Mutiara secara langsung bagi memastikan anda sentiasa peka dengan isu semasa.

programme.title: PETANG KREW
programme.desc: Petang anda pastinya tidak hambar bersama gandingan serasi Amin , Que , Mimie dan Fazrinah! Sambil melayan perjalanan pulang dari kerja, dapatkan pengisian Mutiara Ilmu, tips keusahawanan dalam Biz On Air, serta bincangkan pelbagai Isu hangat dan menarik menerusi Ralet Cheq. Tak lengkap petang anda tanpa menguji minda dalam peraduan Teka Tiara Nyanyi bersama kemaskini trafik dan berita terkini.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: No wonder dogs are man's - and women's - best friend, when they give us so much to laugh about! Daft dogs, singing dogs, disobedient dogs, dogs dressed up to the canines - they're all here, obligingly caught on camera doing something hilarious.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".
But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring field.Dr. Matt has been called in to lend a hand. The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun. But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes. Matt decides to return another day.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking. Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers. Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg. Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Inspector Herchy Boal teams up with the police to attend a property near Birmingham suspected of puppy farming. Herchy discovers a range of breeds including Shih-Tzu’s, West Highland Terriers and Cavashons, but with many pups still yet to be born, how will they all get on?

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt pays his weekly visit to Flamingoland, near Malton in North Yorkshire, and is called to inspect a new arrival, a male Asian Sarus Crane brought in as company to a resident female. They are an endangered species but the cranes haven't yet warmed to each other and Matt offers advice.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property. Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur. One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: This hilarious compilation features dancing dogs, talking dogs, some of the world's cleverest canines - and priceless puppy fails, all caught on camera for our serious amusement. Plus we catch up with the stars of some of the web's most popular dog videos

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Fishes swim in the water. What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! How can one be the creator of the underwater world? Moreover, in this small ecosystem, most players are male and they even jokingly describe each other as "going underwater"; "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to appreciate the mystery of "going underwater"!

This isn’t just another radio show – it’s a full-on experience. Dive into fresh, youth-focused content, spine-chilling horror stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and trending topics that matter to you. We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Chop Chop
programme.desc: A young couple's tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them. When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hell's Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qi's gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qi's husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Circle of Bones
programme.desc: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

programme.desc: Kisah percintaan tragis antara seorang bangsawan misteri, Lee Jang-hyun dan seorang wanita bangsawan berani, Yoo Gil-chae, yang berlaku ketika zaman penjajahan Dinasti Qing di Korea. Dalam suasana perang dan huru-hara, cinta mereka diuji dengan perpisahan, pengorbanan dan penderitaan. Jang-hyun yang menyembunyikan kisah silamnya, mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta dengan Gil-chae. Sementara itu, Gil-chae belajar tentang erti cinta sebenar dan ketabahan melalui liku-liku yang menyayat hati. Lakonan : NamKoong Min, Ahn Eun Jin, Kim Yoon Woo, Lee Da In, Lee Chung-ah dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Isteri Yang Tak Dirindui
programme.desc: Azjar hanya berniaga kecil-kecilan di tepi jalan sebelum bertemu Maria, wanita yang mengubah nasibnya. Dengan bantuan Maria, perniagaannya melonjak naik dan cinta mereka akhirnya membawa ke jinjang pelamin. Namun, di sebalik kebahagiaan itu, Maria menyimpan rahsia. Dia mandul dan terdesak mahukan zuriat. Tekanan demi tekanan membuatkan emosinya tidak stabil. Sampai bila rahsia itu mampu disembunyikan daripada Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama, Wani, pembantu rumah mereka, mula menunjukkan niat tersembunyi. Dia menyukai Azhar dan melihat keretakan rumah tangga itu sebagai peluang.

programme.desc: April dan Dr. Marcel berdepan permulaan yang tegang ketika merawat seorang wanita yang melahirkan anaknya secara bersendirian. Dr. Choi pula menangani seorang pesakit kanser tahap akhir yang mahu menamatkan hidupnya sendiri di hospital, manakala Dr. Manning pula merawat seorang kanak-kanak melecur di pahanya. Maggie melatih seorang jururawat baharu yang suka membanggakan kelayakannya, sementara Dr. Charles pula berdepan dilema apabila isterinya Caroline mahu pembedahan selepas patah pergelangan tangan. RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.
